newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi to build new $48 mln power plant in Tabuk.
newsitem.headline: Saudi to build new $48 mln power plant in Tabuk.

text.p: Saudi Arabia plans to build a new 180 million riyal ($48 million) power plant in Tabuk in northern Saudi Arabia, a Saudi newspaper said on Thursday.
The daily al-Yaum said Tabuk Electric Co chairman Saeed Ali Rabhan would on Tuesday sign the deal with the National Construction Co to build the 57.8 megawatt plant.
The deal covers the integration of the new plant into the main power system, it said. The project will take 30 months to complete.
On Tuesday, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries signed a $1.1 billion deal to build a new 2,400 megawatt power plant for the Saudi Consolidated Electric Company - East.
The plants are part of a drive to raise power generation in the kingdom to 60,000 megawatts over 25 years from a current 19,000 megawatt.
